After a mere five weeks of being enacted, there is talk of having the NH gay marriage law repealed. Opponents of the law were hoping to keep the law at bay while the Republicans make an effort to become a majority in November. It is then that, if elected to a majority, they are expected to attempt the repeal of the law and ban gay marriage.

Despite advances in prevention and treatment, rates of HIV/AIDS in some parts of the U.S. are higher than those in sub-Saharan Africa. Rates of HIV among adults in Washington, D.C. now exceed 1 in 30 -- higher than reported rates in Ethiopia, Nigeria or Rwanda. In New York, rates are higher among blacks (1 in 40) and injection-drug users (1 in 8).

NBC said Thursday it has reached a $45 million deal with Conan O'Brien for his exit from the Tonight Show, allowing Jay Leno to return to the late-night program he hosted for 17 years. Under the deal, which came seven months after O'Brien took the reins from Leno, O'Brien will get more than $33 million, NBC said. The rest will go to his staff.
